review: 406.3a-1: the combat-timing and land-chosen variants flipped on casting timing and on Gonti's cast-only permission, not on 406.3a; replaced Grizzly Bears with the morph card Fathom Seer and made the contrast a face-up cast against a face-down morph cast (406.3a's exception), adding a seventh Swamp for the {3} cost.

406.3b-1: Colfenor's Plans names no spell quality, and its second-spell variant flipped on the Plans' own one-spell limit; rebuilt the scenario on Vivien, Champion of the Wilds (-2, cast only if it's a creature spell), contrasting an exiled Grizzly Bears with an exiled Shock; dropped Llanowar Elves and Colfenor's Plans.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated: no Forge card script moves a card from the exile zone to the exile zone (a search of cardsfolder for an exile effect whose origin includes exile finds none), so an already-exiled card is never exiled again in a Forge game

scenarios.title: An exile effect moves a permanent from the battlefield to the exile zone
decisions: A casts Swords to Plowshares targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains.
B passes priority with Counterspell unused.
Both players pass; Swords to Plowshares resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves from the battlefield to the exile zone and is an exiled card, not in B's graveyard; B gains 2 life (22). Swords to Plowshares resolved and is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response, B casts Counterspell tapping both Islands, and it resolves first.
variants.expected: Swords to Plowshares is countered and goes to A's graveyard; Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield, the exile zone is empty and B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: An exile effect moves cards from the graveyard to the exile zone
decisions: A plays Bojuka Bog as a land; it enters tapped.
Bojuka Bog's enters trigger targets player B.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears and Shock move from B's graveyard to the exile zone; B's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: cards-in-hand
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears and Shock are in B's hand instead of B's graveyard.
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and exiles nothing; Grizzly Bears and Shock stay in B's hand and the exile zone is empty.

scenarios.title: A card exiled face down is turned face up when it is cast from exile

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A casts Gonti, Lord of Luxury tapping four Swamps.
Both players pass; Gonti resolves and enters.
Gonti's enters trigger targets player B; both players pass and it resolves.
A looks at the top four cards of B's library (Fathom Seer, Forest, Mountain, Island), exiles Fathom Seer face down, and the other three go to the bottom of B's library in random order.
In the same main phase A casts the exiled card face up for its mana cost {1}{U}, tapping two Swamps (mana of any type may be spent).
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: While exiled the card is face down with no characteristics. Just before it is cast it turns face up: the spell on the stack is Fathom Seer (blue Illusion, 1/3, mana value 2), and it resolves onto the battlefield face up under A's control.

variants.label: cast-face-down
variants.delta: A casts the exiled card face down using morph for {3}, tapping three Swamps, instead of face up for {1}{U}.
variants.expected: The card is not turned face up: the spell on the stack is a face-down 2/2 colorless creature spell with no name and mana value 0, and it resolves as a face-down 2/2 creature under A's control. Fathom Seer's turned-face-up trigger does not fire.

scenarios.forge_notes: Gonti's permission covers every spell of the exiled card, including its face-down morph cast; Forge models morph as an extra spell ability on the card, which the MayPlay static should offer from exile.

scenarios.title: A face-down exiled card may be cast only if the resulting spell has the quality the permission names

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first. Vivien has been under A's control since before this turn and has not activated a loyalty ability this turn.

decisions: A activates Vivien's -2 ability; both players pass and it resolves.
A looks at the top three cards of A's library (Grizzly Bears, Shock, Forest), exiles Grizzly Bears face down, and puts Shock and Forest on the bottom of A's library.
A casts the exiled Grizzly Bears, tapping two Forests.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting the face-down card is legal (can_play true): A may look at it and the resulting spell is a creature spell. Grizzly Bears resolves onto the battlefield under A's control; Vivien has 2 loyalty.

variants.label: noncreature-exiled
variants.delta: A exiles Shock face down instead of Grizzly Bears, and tries to cast it targeting B with the Mountain.
variants.expected: Casting the face-down Shock is not legal (can_play false): the resulting spell is not a creature spell. Shock stays face down in exile and B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Vivien's play permission is a MayPlay static affecting Creature.IsRemembered in exile; the creature check is made against the card's face-up characteristics.

scenarios.title: A linked leaves-the-battlefield ability returns only the card its own enters ability exiled
decisions: A casts Journey to Nowhere (call it J1), tapping two Plains; it resolves and its enters trigger targets Grizzly Bears.
B passes; the trigger resolves.
A casts a second Journey to Nowhere (J2), tapping two Plains; it resolves and its enters trigger targets Centaur Courser.
B passes; the trigger resolves.
A casts Disenchant targeting J1, tapping two Plains.
B passes; Disenchant resolves, J1 is destroyed and its leaves-the-battlefield trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: J1 goes to A's graveyard. Grizzly Bears returns from exile to the battlefield under B's control. Centaur Courser stays in exile, because J2's linked ability, not J1's, refers to it; J2 stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: nothing-exiled
variants.delta: When J1's enters trigger is on the stack targeting Grizzly Bears, B casts Unsummon on Grizzly Bears, tapping the Island; Unsummon resolves first.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is in B's hand and J1's trigger fizzles, exiling nothing. After Disenchant destroys J1 its leaves trigger returns nothing: Centaur Courser stays in exile, Grizzly Bears stays in B's hand, and the battlefield gains no card.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge links the two Journey abilities by the remembered cards of each Journey object.
